title: 44 Thicket Circle Vacation Rental
meta_description: 44 Thicket Circle is a 4.00 bedroom, 4.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description HOME HIGHLIGHTS: WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pool Passes Included in Rental (Maximum Allotted Wristband Qty is 10) 4 Adult Bikes Included 6 Seater Electric Cart Included Parking for 2 Vehicles Large Private Pool & Spa (Complimentary Pool Heating Available October 1-May 1) Newly Renovated & Professionally Decorated Backs Up To Nature Preserve Propane Grill Screened Porch Located in the Heart of WaterColor's Camp District (4 Minute Walk) 6 Minute Electric Cart Ride to WaterColor's Beach Club Access 7 Minute Bike Ride to Seaside DETAILS:Welcome to 44 Thicket Circle – Your Serene Escape in WaterColor. Tucked between a tranquil nature preserve and a quiet park just across the street, this beautifully renovated 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom retreat offers an exceptional sense of privacy, peace, and comfort in the heart of WaterColor. Just steps from the excitement of Camp WaterColor, the home strikes the perfect balance between refined coastal luxury and relaxed, family-friendly charm—making it an ideal getaway for those looking to unwind, reconnect, and explore all that 30A has to offer. Recently renovated with both style and relaxation in mind, every detail of this home has been elevated with thoughtful upgrades and high-end finishes. Step inside to bright, airy interiors featuring crisp white walls, warm wood accents, and curated coastal décor that create a welcoming, laid-back elegance. The open-concept main level seamlessly connects the living, dining, and kitchen areas—ideal for quality time together. The living room offers an oversized sectional, plush armchairs, and a flat-screen TV, perfect for unwinding after a beach day. The chef’s kitchen is sleek and well-equipped, with white quartz countertops, stainless-steel appliances (including a gas range), and ample cabinetry. A custom wet bar nook welcomes guests with chilled drinks and cocktails from the built-in beverage refrigerator, while a second drink fridge is tucked away in the spacious pantry. The newly enclosed side porch adds generous additional living space. Also on this floor is a convenient half bath and a beautifully appointed guest suite with a plush king bed and private en suite featuring a private bathroom with walk-in shower. Upstairs, the primary suite is a peaceful sanctuary with a king bed, a private balcony overlooking the nature preserve and pool, and a spa-style en suite with a walk-in shower and separate soaking tub. Two additional guest rooms—one with a king bed and one with a queen—each offer private en suites, providing comfort and space for everyone. The laundry area is also conveniently located on this level. Take in the lush surroundings from the expansive second-floor covered porch—perfect for morning coffee or sunset cocktails. Downstairs, a large screened-in porch invites you to gather around the fire pit, creating an ideal space to relax in every season. The private pool completes the experience, offering yet another place to soak up the serenity. For added convenience and fun, your stay includes a 6-seater electric cart and four adult bikes—making it easy to explore WaterColor’s trails, pools, and nearby 30A hotspots. With Camp WaterColor just steps away—featuring two large pools and a lazy river—and the WaterColor Beach Club, tennis center, community pools, and sugar-white sands just a short golf cart ride away, plus nearby dining and shopping in Seaside, 44 Thicket Circle delivers the ultimate balance of adventure, luxury, and laid-back charm. Let Sanders Beach Rentals help you plan your unforgettable stay at 44 Thicket Circle—where natural beauty, modern comfort, and timeless memories await.
